candidates.violated_requirement: Incorrect state transition when processing the sixth bit of a matching sequence. When data is 0 (last bit of sequence 011100), it should transition to s6 to indicate match, but instead transitions to sf6 causing not_match to assert.
candidates.spec_basis: Output should assert match when sequence 011100 is detected (spec section 'Module Description')

candidates.violated_requirement: Incorrect handling of fail state sf5 transition - should unconditionally go to sf6 but instead introduces data-dependent transition that could incorrectly return to matching path
candidates.spec_basis: Once a mismatch is detected (sf path), should continue through fail states (spec section 'state machine behavior')
